nodes.name: configmap.yaml
nodes.summary: ConfigMap supplying BIND9 named.conf plus master zone files for the http01.example.com and dns01.example.com test zones used by cert-manager end-to-end tests.
nodes.languageNotes: Zone files use IP placeholder tokens such as {SERVICE_IP_PREFIX} that the test harness substitutes before applying the manifest.

nodes.name: deployment.yaml
nodes.summary: Kubernetes Deployment that runs a BIND9 DNS server on UDP port 8053 for cert-manager integration tests, mounting the bind ConfigMap into /etc/bind.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a fixed runAsUser/runAsGroup of 101 so the named process runs as the in-image bind user, and disables image pulls for locally loaded test images.

nodes.name: service.yaml
nodes.summary: ClusterIP Service exposing the BIND test DNS server on UDP port 53 with a hardcoded cluster IP so tests can address it directly by address.
